verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Supabase has a JavaScript Auth API reference page and a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.json). However, nothing documents an interactive reference or runnable/try-it examples. An OpenAPI file is a building block someone could use to construct an interactive explorer, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
